description: Use this when finishing a Buyer Assurance check. Pass the `terms_id` from assurance_prepare and mode PUBLIC_REPLAY (GAIP replays the service) or BUYER_SUBMITTED. Returns PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN per check and a delivery receipt. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

body.description: BUYER_SUBMITTED: the response body you received (max 32 KiB).

body_sha256.description: BUYER_SUBMITTED: SHA-256 of the body, instead of the body.

data_classification.description: PUBLIC (default) or NON_PERSONAL_PUBLIC. Never send personal data.

http_status.description: BUYER_SUBMITTED: the HTTP status you received.

mode.description: PUBLIC_REPLAY: GAIP fetches the public URL itself. BUYER_SUBMITTED: check a response you pass in.

terms_id.description: The terms_id returned when the terms were registered.

name: assurance_complete
title: Complete a buyer-side delivery check
